/*
 * Second Test suite for nsAbAutoCompleteSearch - test follow-on lookup after
 * a previous search.
 *
 * We run this test without address books, constructing manually ourselves,
 * so that we can ensure that we're not getting the data out of the address
 * books.
 */

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The accepted narrowing path only reuses a successful compatible previous result and copies its getValueAt and getLabelAt separately. test_nsAbAutoCompleteSearch2 builds results without address books and uses an en-dash label, then expects that exact label; fresh labels use an em dash. Preserve previous labels in this branch rather than silently regenerating them from the current formatter. The dash difference is not evidence for a general punctuation standard or an author’s unstated intent. This is static source and test-code inspection. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check ran. Full Bugzilla and historical review timeline and inline discussion remain pending; source landing does not prove approval of a proposed manual rule.
title: A follow-on autocomplete reduction preserves the previous display label
